messages:
harper: FYI we had an automatic fallback flip into quarantine-mode for /v2/completions for ~18s this morning. only a handful of 502s but the console showed a hard quarantine and on-call got an alert :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

nate: quarantine-mode? i thought that only triggers for sustained failures. which rule fired?

harper: it was the new combinator that treats error-rate + downstream-timeouts + db-throttle as a composite. the short timeout burst + a temporary spike in db-throttle pushed the composite score over the hard quarantine threshold.

jing: sounds like we need clearer signal semantics. proposal: split policies into "graceful-fallback" (redirects to lower-cost replica) vs "quarantine" (sends 503+page). each should have independent persistence windows and a spike-guard.

mohit: agree. also console must show which policy category fired and the exact arithmetic used. a human-friendly decision line would help: "policy=quarantine_v1;score=0.91;top=timeout:0.6,db_throttle:0.25"

harper: +1. and add a small stability hint like "revert_in=22s" so ops know when it may revert without action.

nate: about audit: keep main audit rows compact. store fields as flat strings only, example: `policy=quarantine_v1;reason=timeout+db;sample=req_2026_ab12;stability=22s`. avoid nested JSON so the console can render directly.

jing: how about sampled payloads? retention and cost are real concerns. we should only store full payloads for requests that triggered degradations or had 5xx. default sample rate 1% for degraded requests, 0.1% for normal traffic. on-call can request a temporary elevated fetch token valid for 15m.

mohit: RBAC: only on-call and platform-eng should fetch full payloads. UI should show a disabled "fetch sample" button with tooltip when the role lacks permission.

harper: inbox UX: group events per route into a single thread, include count and last 5 contributors. allow quick actions: Snooze (5m/30m/1h), Annotate, Escalate. Snooze should write an audit annotation like `annot=route_snooze;by=harper;dur=30m`.

nate: add oscillation protection: if a route flips policy >4 times within 15m, increase the persistence window by x2 and suppress page for the next flip. also log oscillation_count in the audit row.

jing: small API change: decision service expose `/v1/policy/evaluate?route=/v2/completions&window=30s` and return a compact semicolon-delimited string blob as Nate suggested. fields must be top-level strings only. include `stability_hint` and `oscillation_count`.

mohit: console feature: show an inline tiny banner on route page when any fallback is active: badge text (GRACEFUL / QUARANTINE) + one-line reason. clicking expands a compact panel with top3 signals, score, and CTA buttons (Snooze / Force-revert *if* permitted / Create incident).

harper: we also should allow a read-only view for product/devs that shows only the human-friendly reason without links to samples. avoids accidental data exposure.

nate: testing: add a small playground endpoint so engineers can simulate combinations of signals and preview the decision blob. helpful for debugging policy math.

ops-bot: deploy: quarantine-policy-clarity -> canary 1% at 09:12 UTC :rocket:

jing: action items: jing -> propose default persistence windows + spike_guard rules; nate -> spec flat decision blob and SDK parse helper; mohit -> inbox grouping mock + RBAC rules; harper -> short on-call runbook snippet. i'll open a small RFC and link the playground in it.

harper: thanks all :thumbsup:
